name: Symbol of Persuasion (Heightened) Trap (CR 10)
body:
Heightened Symbol of Persuasion Trap
CR 10

XP 9,600

Type magic; Perception DC 34; Disable Device DC 34

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset automatic (10 minutes); Bypass password

Effect spell effect (permanent heightened symbol of persuasion [9th level, CL 18th]; targets are charmed as charm monster for 18 hours, DC 24 Will save negates, charmed targets are compelled to remain docile and wait until a predetermined event occurs or a set amount of time elapses; multiple targets (all targets passing through the door.)
